overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The Law does not require posting minutes to a website, and the Committee approved the minutes within an appropriate time. The complaint was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to publish its July 26, Sept 13 and Sept 27 meeting minutes to its website.
allegations.key_passage: The Law does not require that minutes be published to a website, however.

allegations.summary: Addressed in the course of the publishing complaint: whether the Committee approved the July 26, Sept 13 and Sept 27 minutes in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: We find this to be an appropriate amount of time for approving minutes.
